name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Member Services Manager | Team Leadership, Escalated Issue Resolution & Process Improvement
summary: Operations and client-service leader with 15+ years managing teams and resolving escalated issues for clients who depend on getting accurate answers. Directly managed and developed a team of up to 20 people, built the coaching, performance-review, and process-improvement discipline that comes with it, and has a consistent record of translating complex systems into clear guidance for both employees and clients. No direct benefits-administration or financial-services background specifically, worth stating plainly, but the underlying skill, leading a team through complex, judgment-heavy casework and improving the process as it goes, is the same one built across a 15-year career.

Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Analyze complex marketing and operational datasets, extracting actionable insights and structured recommendations that improve campaign performance.
Design self-improving evaluation frameworks to monitor output quality and continuously optimize processes.
